description:
Python code accompanying the manuscript "Incremental value of large language model-extracted discharge-summary flags for antimicrobial resistance prediction: a retrospective cohort study with temporal validation in an Indian tertiary-care hospital" (submitted to BMC Medical Informatics and Decision Making).

The scripts cover de-identification, cohort construction and labelling of MRSA, ESBL and CRE, structured feature engineering, rule-based and large language model (Claude Sonnet 5) extraction of 13 clinical flags from discharge summaries, physician-validation sampling and scoring, model development (logistic regression, random forest, XGBoost) with a calendar-ordered, patient-exclusive temporal split, patient-cluster bootstrap comparisons with multiplicity correction, recalibration, decision curve analysis, SHAP, subgroup, decomposition and sensitivity analyses, data-quality checks, and generation of all tables and figures.

Patient-level data are not included; see the README for the expected inputs and run order.
